bikes.description: Pristine condition Hunter 350. Smooth clutch, agile for Hyderabad traffic and weekend trips to Gandipet / Vikarabad. Serviced every 3,000 km.
Hyper-responsive naked streetfighter with VVA engine and quick-shifter. Perfect for daily campus commutes and Shankerpally cruising. Comes with phone mount.
Reliable, powerful, and very fuel efficient with 3 ride modes (Urban, Rain, Sport). Ideal for long study group sessions in Gachibowli or Hitec City.
Aggressive acceleration with WP APEX suspension and dual-channel ABS. Handled strictly with care. Renter must have prior geared motorcycle experience.
Smart EV scooter with Warp Mode, onboard Google Maps navigation, and 105 km true range per charge. Home charging cable included. Perfect eco-friendly ride.
The easiest, most comfortable automatic scooter on campus. Generous under-seat storage for your backpack and study materials. Very smooth ride.
Full-fairing quarter-litre highway machine. Smooth oil-cooled engine with immense mid-range punch. In maintenance check for new brake pads this week.
